title: Street-Style Plant-Based Kofta Pitas
subtitle: with Cucumber and Tomato Salad
description: Looking for dinner on the table quick smart? These fast recipes are ready in 25 minutes or less and all come with yumness guaranteed.

steps.text: Make salad: Preheat the oven to 200C, fan-forced (see Make it faster). Thinly slice the onion and cucumber with a sharp knife or mandoline. Thinly slice the tomato. Combine 1 tbs olive oil and 2 tsp red wine vinegar in a large bowl and season with salt and pepper. Add the onion, cucumber and tomato and toss to combine.
Warm pita: Halve the pita to form 4 pockets, put in a single layer on an oven tray and cover the tray with foil. Heat in the oven for 10 mins or until softened and warmed through.

Make koftas: Meanwhile, combine the plant-based mince and kofta seasoning in a large bowl and season with salt and pepper. Using damp hands, combine well, then shape into 4 oval-shaped koftas. Heat 2 tsp olive oil in a medium frypan over medium-high heat. Cook the koftas, turning, for 6-8 mins until browned and cooked through. Remove the pan from the heat.
Make garlic mayo: Crush ½ garlic clove. Combine the garlic, 2 tbs mayonnaise and 1 tsp water in a bowl and season with salt and pepper.
Serve up: Gently open up the pita pockets, fill with the kofta and salad and drizzle with the garlic mayo. Divide the pita among plates and serve with any remaining salad. Enjoy!

Make it faster: We've warmed the pita in the oven, but you can use a microwave instead. Halve the pita to form 4 pockets. Put on a plate, slightly overlapping, and microwave for 30 secs or until warmed through.
